battle_traits.name: The Lurking Vermintide
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN unit that has not been deployed.
battle_traits.effect: Set up that unit in reserve in the tunnels below. It has now been deployed.

battle_traits.name: Always Three Clawsteps Ahead
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly non-MONSTER SKAVEN unit that is not in combat and was not set up this turn to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect: That unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

battle_traits.name: Too Quick to Hit-hit
battle_traits.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY and CAVALRY units by RETREAT abilities.

battle_traits.name: Splinters of the Vermindoom
battle_traits.declare: You can use this ability if there are fewer than 3 friendly Gnawholes on the battlefield.
battle_traits.effect: Set up a Gnawhole on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 1" from all other terrain features.

battle_traits.name: Gnawhole Ambush
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN unit that is in the tunnels below to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly Gnawhole and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Corrupted Earth
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly PESTILENS units that are in combat to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
For each target:
• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Prized Creations
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-HERO MOULDER units to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:
1-2 Self-destructive Fury: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
3-4 Rabid Infusion: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
5-6 Blinded by Frenzy: In addition to the effect of 'Rabid Infusion', the target has WARD (5+) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Claw-picked
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly VERMINUS units that charged this turn to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets' melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Skryre Prototypes
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly SKRYRE units to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:
1 Kaboom!: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
2-5 More Power!: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.
6 More-more Power!: In addition to the effect of 'More Power!', add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Kill-kill! Scurry-flee!
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy HERO to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, if the target has been destroyed, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly ESHIN units.

abilities.name: Will of the Horned Rat
abilities.effect:
While a friendly SKAVEN DAEMON is within the combat range of a friendly non-HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY unit:
• That SKAVEN DAEMON has WARD (4+).
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that SKAVEN DAEMON, allocate 1 mortal damage on a friendly non-HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY unit within that unit's combat range after the damage sequence for that unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for these damage points).

abilities.name: Backstabbing Allies
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a friendly SKAVEN unit
abilities.effect:
Pick up to 2 other friendly SKAVEN units that are not in combat and are wholly within 13"
of the unit using the 'Redeploy' command to be the targets. Each target must have at least one of the following keywords: VERMINUS, SKRYRE, MOULDER, PESTILENS, ESHIN. After that 'Redeploy' command has been resolved, each of the targets can immediately use the 'Redeploy' command in an order of your choice without any command points being spent.

entries.name: Scurry Away
entries.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.

entries.name: Short-tempered
entries.effect: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly SKAVEN units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

entries.name: Skilled Manipulator
entries.effect:
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY unit:
• This unit has WARD (4+).
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY unit within this unit's combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

entries.name: Devious Underling
entries.declare: Pick another friendly SKAVEN HERO on the battlefield with a Health characteristic that equals or exceeds this unit's Health characteristic to be the target.
entries.effect:
For the rest of the battle:
• While the target has not been slain, friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY units have WARD (6+) while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
• Once the target has been slain, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

entries.name: Fleshmeddler
entries.declare: Pick a friendly MOULDER unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Pit Tinkerer
entries.effect: You can re-roll the random characteristic rolls for the Move characteristic of friendly SKRYRE WAR MACHINES while they are wholly within 13" of this unit. In addition, each time a friendly SKRYRE WAR MACHINE wholly within 18" of this unit uses the 'Rolling Doom' or 'Whirling Doom' ability, add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted, if any.

entries.name: Masterclan Connections
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared a SPELL or UNBIND ability for a visible SKAVEN unit wholly within 13" of this unit
entries.effect: Add D3 to that casting roll or unbinding roll.

entries.name: Master of the Swarm
entries.effect: Each time an ability returns 1 or more slain models to a friendly SKAVEN unit wholly within 13" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

entries.name: Essence of the Gnaw
entries.declare: Pick another visible friendly SKAVEN unit wholly within 13" of this unit and in combat to be the target.
entries.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit has STRIKE-FIRST and the target has STRIKE-LAST.

entries.name: Foulhide
entries.effect: Heal (D3) this unit.

entries.name: Warpstone Charm
entries.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Skavenbrew
entries.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Transplanted Brains
entries.effect:
Pick 1 of the following brains. Its effects apply for the rest of the turn:
Warpstone Addict's Brain:
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's combat attacks.
• This unit has a maximum control score of 1.
Warlock Whelp's Brain: Add 10 to this unit's control score.

entries.name: Anabolic Accelerators
entries.effect: If this unit was set up this turn, when making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

entries.name: Serrated Bone Protrusions
entries.effect: For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by an enemy unit that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.name: Skitterleap
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly SKAVEN HERO wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Wither
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

entries.name: Warpgale
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: The target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn

entries.name: Filth-crust
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, the target's melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Bile-torrent
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 4+ instead.

entries.name: Rabid-tough
entries.declare: Pick a friendly SKAVEN PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly SKAVEN INFANTRY unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that unit until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn

entries.name: Summon Warp Lightning Vortex
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Warp Lightning Vortex on the battlefield, pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up the first part of the Warp Lightning Vortex within 18" of the caster and visible to them, then set up the second and third parts exactly 7" from the first part and exactly 7" from each other so that they form a triangle.

entries.name: Summon Vermintide
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Vermintide on the battlefield, pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Vermintide wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Bell of Doom
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Bell of Doom on the battlefield, pick a friendly SKAVEN WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Bell of Doom wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
